name: Marble City India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Marble City India Ltd is in the business of cutting,  finishing, and trading of Imported Marble[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is an importer cum processor of marbles from quarries across the world. It cuts, resizes, and polishes raw marble  blocks for customers in the commercial 
and residential real estate space.

cons: Stock is trading at 4.76 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.88 Cr.
